answer: Random transcript audit works like a surprise oral exam for past work. Each epoch the chain selects one archived answer and issues a fresh nonce cipher, forcing the author to re-derive its reasoning live; a karst-like network of thin, isolated verification channels ensures no cached replay can seep through. The verifier recomputes the stored derivation against the new nonce and compares the signal trajectory step by step. One mismatch flags the identity; a second within 72 hours freezes emissions and routes it to manual review.
